data.name: Mason Dixon Saloon
data.tagline: Good Food. Cold Drinks. Great Times.
data.about: If you're a meat connoisseur, you know the difference an in-house smoker can make. You won't be disappointed when you visit Mason Dixon Saloon for delicious smoked meats. We smoke our pork baby back ribs and slow cook the meat for our Reubens. We even have a special dry rub for wings, burgers, pork baby back ribs, pork loins and beef loins.

reviews.text: Stopped here on my way to Wyoming, best ribs I've ever had, literally falling off the bone, wonderful flavor, and super friendly staff
reviews.name: Thomas C.

reviews.text: Food was wonderful! Ribs, pulled pork, beef brisket, and 5 bean salad on the sampler was amazing!! My wife had the pulled pork quesadilla and cheese fries. Did NOT disappoint, we will be back!
reviews.name: Seth W.

reviews.text: The ribs are amazing. Great atmosphere and staff.
reviews.name: Kurt D

reviews.text: Fantastic wings. Great service. Pleasurable experience. Will return.
reviews.name: Jason D.

reviews.text: Awesome Atmosphere, great bartenders and staff. Music selection is perfect blend. Drinks made just right.
reviews.name: Nate H.

reviews.text: Excellent food. Very clean establishment Friendly, efficient staff! Highly recommend
reviews.name: Sherri H.

reviews.text: I met the owner Joe tonight. What a great guy! The design of this bar is definitely worth checking out! Then stick around for the great bartenders, friendly people and awesome music!

data.name: The Holler Inn
data.tagline: Where Small Town Folks Get Fed Right.
data.about: The Holler Inn is a trailside bar and grill in downtown Browntown, Wisconsin, right off Highway 11 and the Cheese Country ATV and snowmobile trail. We serve pizza, wraps, fresh never frozen burgers and ice cold beer, with live music, karaoke and raffles through the year. Stop in after a ride, bring the whole crew, and we will take care of you.

reviews.name: Julie Rackow
reviews.text: Went to try pizza heard they were so good and we had supreme it was soooo good. Will go back again and try other ones they have. One of the best pizzas I've ever had, highly recommend.

reviews.name: Chris Buikema
reviews.text: Made a stop on the ATV-UTV Cheese Trail. Food was very good, very friendly staff! Very attentive to whatever you want. Bloody Marys were good, made with Tito's without having to ask. Chicken quesadilla was perfect.

reviews.name: Megan Thomas
reviews.text: Visiting my sister on Mother's Day 2026, we wanted to check out The Holler Inn. So glad we did! Ordered the Shrimp, Wild Rice and Broccoli special and definitely was filled up! Delicious!

reviews.name: Ryan Nicosia
reviews.text: Cool spot for a cold beer or other adult beverages. They had live music on our visit and the guy playing was great.

reviews.name: Stephanie Reynolds
reviews.text: Amazing food and friendly staff! We love coming here!

reviews.name: Ryan Klemm
reviews.text: First trip here, definitely won't be my last. Had the pizza, very impressed!

feature.title: The Trail Boss
feature.desc: Our signature hand mixed smashed patty topped with smoked Gouda cheese, crispy fried onion petals on our house made 'Boss Sauce', a creamy smoky sauce with just the right amount of tang and attitude.
feature.source: Our entry in the Green County Beef Producers' Best Burger Contest.
feature.howTitle: How the Best Burger Contest works
feature.howSub: Run by the Green County Beef Producers. Every contest burger you eat earns a stamp on your voting card.
steps: Order the contest burger and ask your server for a voting card.
Get your card stamped before you leave. One burger is one stamp, so if you share a burger, you share the vote.
Try at least half of the contest burgers (12 of 24 in 2026) for your vote to count.
Each burger you try adds a point to your favorite. Try all of them and your #1 gets the most points.
Send your card to the Green County Beef Producers by August 6.
12 or more stamps puts you in the gift card drawing. Try every burger to enter the beef bundle grand prize drawing.
feature.note: Voting runs April 1 to July 31 each year. The 2027 contest starts April 1, 2027.
